verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a REST API that can create, read, update and delete store data in JSON using scoped read/write API keys. It also documents webhooks that push event notifications to a chosen URL, plus native MCP support, a CLI and official client libraries, so an agent can plausibly read and update orders without the admin. The evidence never names order-status endpoints, shipment or fulfillment endpoints, or a returns flow. Fulfillment is described mainly through the human dashboard and label printing, and refunds appear only in the WooPayments money-management guide, not as an API capability. Missing for 10: explicit order-status and fulfillment/tracking API documentation, a documented returns/refunds API, order-lifecycle webhook topics, and hands-on or independent corroboration of fully headless post-purchase handling.
